title: CRPD/C/WSM/CO/1 — Concerns/Observations (CRPD)
text: Right to life (art. 10) 17.The Committee notes with concern the lack of disability-disaggregated data on mental health and the need to ensure that all mental health policies, including those providing crisis support for suicide prevention, are disability-inclusive.
themes: Economic & political crisis, natural disasters or other emergencies
sdgs: 3.4 - Reduce mortality from non-communicable diseases and promote mental health
